thread:
nina: Morning mystery: three muffins went missing overnight. No crumbs, just empty box. Whos the muffin bandit? :eyes:

omar: not me, i only brought sadness and a granola bar. but if you find crumbs ill confess to being a suspect.

felix: guilty: i relocated one muffin to my desk because i thought it was a communal 'free snacks' donation. my bad. returning it now.

nina: phew. mystery partly solved. still 2 unaccounted for. whoever took them please leave a ransom note or a coffee in return. :coffee:

ops-bot: Kitchen inventory update: paper_towels=1_roll, oat_milk=0.5_carton, muffins=0. Current low thresholds triggered for paper_towels and oat_milk.

tara: omg oat milk at 0.5? i didn't realize. can someone pick up a backup stash (small shelf-stable boxes) just in case?

ben: I can do a quick run at lunch. Preference: 1L chilled cartons or shelf-stable for pantry?

omar: chilled if possible. the shelf coffee tastes weird with shelf-stable. also were out of medium roast beans by the machine (ops-bot, FYI).

ops-bot: Bean inventory: medium_roast=0.2kg, dark_roast=0.9kg. Suggested reorder: medium_roast.

felix: also the sink was clogged this morning with grounds. reminder: dump portafilter puck in the compost bin not sink. pls.

nina: can we pin a small note by the machine: "NO GROUNDS IN SINK"? Saves plumbing and my tears.

tara: i'll print a sticky. also adding "muffins: communal unless labeled" sign to avoid future heists.

ben: run list: 2L CloudFarm oat milk, 1kg medium roast, 2 rolls paper towels, 6 assorted muffins (for peace offering). I'll post receipt and split. ETA 45 mins.

omar: bless you. will volunteer to be taste tester for muffins. rigorous scientific duty. :test_tube:

ops-bot: Action created: grocery_run_by_ben. ETA=45m. Reminder to report receipt in thread.

felix: if anyone wants to memorialize the muffin bandit, i propose a small cardboard crown near the kitchen for a day. playful deterrent.

nina: love it. make it tasteful. they shall be crowned at 3pm if unclaimed. :crown:

ben: receipt posted: https://imgur.com/muffinrun224567 (total $27.64). splitting 4 ways = $6.91 each. tagging nina, omar, tara.

tara: paid. thanks ben and merry muffin truce everyone.

omar: paid. crown pending. :crown:
